cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
c = open('/root/Caddyfile').read()
if 'cabinet.unitex.od.ua' in c:
    open('/root/Caddyfile.new','w').write(c); print('CADDY: ВЖЕ Є')
else:
    block = ("\ncabinet.unitex.od.ua {\n\tencode gzip\n"
             "\treverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8793\n}\n")
    open('/root/Caddyfile.new','w').write(c.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + block)
    print('CADDY: ДОПИСАНО')
PY
BAK=/root/Caddyfile.bak-cabinet-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
cp /root/Caddyfile "$BAK"; echo "копія: $BAK"
echo "== різниця =="
diff /root/Caddyfile /root/Caddyfile.new
echo "== перевірка конфігу в окремому контейнері =="
if docker run --rm -v /root/Caddyfile.new:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro caddy:2-alpine \
     caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/tmp/cv-cab.log 2>&1; then
  echo "VALIDATE_OK"
  cp /root/Caddyfile.new /root/Caddyfile
  docker exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/tmp/cr-cab.log 2>&1 \
    && echo "RELOAD_OK" || { echo "reload не вдався, перезапускаю контейнер"; tail -2 /tmp/cr-cab.log; docker restart caddy >/dev/null; sleep 8; }
  sleep 12
  echo "== ЕРП на місці? =="
  echo "UI: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://134.209.94.12/)"
  echo "== кабінет ззовні =="
  echo "CAB_HEALTH: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://cabinet.unitex.od.ua/health)"
  echo "CAB_ROOT:   $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://cabinet.unitex.od.ua/)"
  echo "== сертифікат =="
  echo | openssl s_client -connect cabinet.unitex.od.ua:443 -servername cabinet.unitex.od.ua 2>/dev/null \
    | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates 2>/dev/null
else
  echo "VALIDATE_FAIL — конфіг НЕ міняю"; tail -5 /tmp/cv-cab.log
fi
